places.raw_name: a rolling plain bare of trees
places.name: Treeless plain south of the Red River
places.note: Heavy rain catches the herd two days short of the Red; the crew spends a sodden night on horseback.
places.location_hint: rolling treeless prairie in north Texas, about two days' drive south of the Red River, north of Fort Worth

places.name: Red River
places.note: Feared for quicksand, it marks the edge of the outfit's known country; Deets finds a gravel bar downstream and the herd crosses safely.

places.name: Indian Territory
places.note: The herd grazes on wet grass north of the Red; the crew camps there with Irish and Spanish songs while Call camps apart.
places.location_hint: just north of the Red River crossing

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Newt fondly remembers its dry, clear days amid the downpour.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Dish recalls bogging cattle in the Red on an earlier drive, further east toward Arkansas.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: camped just north of the Red River crossing
